title: Yes No Game (F4A (Cut Intro))
description: Who wants to play a little game with me? It’s pretty simple, and there’s really just one rule. Whenever I say “Yes”, you have permission to pleasure yourself. The more I say it, the more I moan it, the faster you have to go! But if I say “No”, you have to stop. Right then and there. No excuses. Hands at your side. I'm going to have you on edge sweetheart. Doesn’t that sound fun? A lovely commission for a wonderful writer... Come play along. By the end of it, there will only be one word you’re begging for me to say…
author: Mistress Shibby
